POST-PROCESSING GAP REDUCTION: Improving the calibration of deep neural networks (DNNs) is critical for reliable uncertainty estimation.
Conclusions: Ensuring accurate and trustworthy confidence scores in deep neural networks is vital for deploying them in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, autonomous driving, and finance.
Related Work: These limitations underscore the need for robust calibration methods to enhance reliability in domains such as autonomous driving (Feng et al., 2021) and medical imaging (Mehrtash et al., 2020).
